description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle data source, JPA configuration, SQL syntax, and schema to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including converting photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the application's database connectivity and data model from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Update datasource and JPA configuration, convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, and migrate photo storage from BLOB to bytea. Configure database authentication to use Managed Identity instead of plaintext credentials.
